scope: local static source-first reference contract intake for UE rendering, ROS2, FAST-LIO, planner, and RflySim-like simulator patterns

entries.source_version_or_runtime: AirSim ROS wrapper documentation, ROS1-era semantics
entries.reusable_pattern: GPS, odometry, camera, IMU, magnetometer, distance, LiDAR PointCloud2, takeoff/land/reset services, NED/ENU frame parameters
entries.version_risk: ROS1 naming and AirSim runtime assumptions must be translated to MoSim ROS2/Humble and project frames
entries.why: The topic/frame discipline is directly useful, but AirSim must not become the MoSim runtime authority.
entries.required_local_gate: Static contract must map each adopted topic/frame to MoSim producer, consumer, frequency, frame_id, and evidence source.
forbidden_claims: AirSim runtime is a MoSim dependency
PointCloud2 display alone proves FAST-LIO localization
AirSim odometry is MoSim truth
entries.next_task_candidate: Draft ROS2 topic/frame contract table for LiDAR, IMU, odometry, path, planner setpoint, and review topics.

entries.reusable_pattern: requestApiControl gate, goal mode/value, goal timestamp, API timeout entering hover, arm/disarm state checks
entries.version_risk: AirSim firmware state machine is not MWORKS; semantics must be rewritten as controller/setpoint adapter logic.
entries.why: The timeout and API-control gate are exactly the safety shape MoSim needs for UE console commands and stale setpoints.
entries.required_local_gate: MWORKS/ROS2 adapter smoke must reject commands without authority and echo timeout/fallback reason.
forbidden_claims: AirSim firmware behavior proves MoSim controller performance
UE command accepted before MWORKS/ROS2 echo
Timeout hover implemented without local adapter evidence
entries.next_task_candidate: Encode stale-command timeout and rejected-command echo fields in the command/status schema.

entries.reusable_pattern: /$topics discovery, subscribe/unsubscribe frames, callback registration, subscription token invalidation
entries.version_risk: Transport details are ProjectAirSim-specific and should not be copied into MoSim before the narrower UDP/schema path is stable.
entries.why: Useful later for introspection and UI topic browsing, but not required for the first MoSim command/echo gate.
entries.required_local_gate: Only promote after MoSim has a stable topic manifest and adapter-owned producer/consumer registry.
forbidden_claims: MoSim needs ProjectAirSim transport
Topic discovery replaces explicit ROS2FrameTopicContract
entries.next_task_candidate: Keep as later UX/reference item for a topic browser after P0 contracts pass.

entries.reusable_pattern: URI-style command templates, handler registration, command aliasing, game-thread execution guard, request/reply status
entries.version_risk: UnrealCV plugin API and command strings are not MoSim-specific; implementation must be adapted to MoSim schemas and UE5 project layout.
entries.why: This is a proven UE-side command-dispatch shape for a simulator console without direct actor-pose control.
entries.required_local_gate: Source-static checker must prove MoSim UE commands route through schema validation and do not call direct transform/pose override APIs.
forbidden_claims: UnrealCV command handlers are already integrated into MoSim
UE command execution proves MWORKS/ROS2 acceptance
Direct actor transform is allowed for UAV control
entries.next_task_candidate: Create a source-static checklist for UE command handler registration, reject paths, and echo display.

entries.reusable_pattern: lit, depth, normal, optical_flow, object_mask, base_color, unlit, wireframe view modes and camera sensor components
entries.version_risk: Camera capture APIs and material paths must match MoSimSceneLibrary and cannot be assumed runtime-ready.
entries.why: MoSim can avoid reinventing render/sensor review modes by adapting this sensor-oracle pattern.
entries.required_local_gate: UE source/build or screenshot evidence must prove each enabled mode renders a nonblank expected artifact.
forbidden_claims: UE depth/mask is planner truth
Sensor oracle proves controller success
Runtime sensor output exists without UE build/runtime evidence
entries.next_task_candidate: Define first sensor-oracle subset: RGB/lit, depth, object mask, collision oracle review.

entries.source_version_or_runtime: mavros-ros2, Humble+ support noted in local README
entries.reusable_pattern: ROS2 Humble+ support, plugin container, OFFBOARD mode, position/velocity setpoint test pattern
entries.version_risk: PX4/MAVROS runtime should not be introduced into the first MoSim loop unless explicitly approved.
entries.why: OFFBOARD keepalive/state semantics are useful for MoSim setpoint safety even when PX4 is not the runtime.
entries.required_local_gate: Contract must specify setpoint frequency, stale timeout, mode/armed/connected status, and fallback.
forbidden_claims: PX4 is active in the MoSim loop
MAVROS plugin evidence is MoSim controller evidence
Offboard mode is complete without local setpoint/echo evidence
entries.next_task_candidate: Translate OFFBOARD mode/keepalive/state fields into MoSim command echo schema.

entries.version_risk: Field names must be normalized for MoSim; not all PX4/APM modes apply.
entries.why: These fields prevent a UI from showing accepted command state without explicit mode/connection/armed evidence.
entries.required_local_gate: Schema review must show equivalent fields in MoSim command echo and blocker conditions for missing mode/state evidence.
forbidden_claims: All MAVROS modes are supported by MoSim
Mode string alone proves controller readiness
entries.next_task_candidate: Add mode/state echo checklist to PMO acceptance of UE/ROS2 command packets.

entries.source_version_or_runtime: ROS1 FAST-LIO with Livox Mid360 config
entries.version_risk: Local FAST_LIO sample is ROS1/catkin; direct runtime on ROS2 is rejected unless a bridge/container/candidate route is approved.
entries.why: The Mid360 input/output semantics are high-value and should drive MoSim topic/message checks.
entries.required_local_gate: ROS2 route must prove real FAST-LIO-family runtime output topics and truth-error evaluation before localization claims.
forbidden_claims: ROS1 FAST_LIO is a native ROS2 runtime
Nonzero point cloud proves localization
/mosim/replay_odometry is FAST-LIO odometry
entries.next_task_candidate: Freeze Mid360 input fields, timestamp monotonicity, extrinsics, and output-topic acceptance checks.

entries.reusable_pattern: Livox CustomMsg/CustomPoint semantics and preprocess expectations
entries.version_risk: These are not current MoSim ROS2 runtime candidates by themselves.
entries.why: Useful for checking message compatibility and avoiding field loss, not for claiming runtime.
entries.required_local_gate: Any promoted runtime must pass local ROS2 build/run and topic/quality checks.
forbidden_claims: FAST-LIVO2 or Point-LIO is currently accepted runtime
Message header existence proves executable compatibility
entries.next_task_candidate: Use as a schema compatibility checklist when testing ROS2 FAST-LIO candidates.

entries.reusable_pattern: mars_quadrotor_msgs::msg::PositionCommand subscription on /planning/pos_cmd, odom/pose/path/PointCloud2 publishers, map_ego TF
entries.version_risk: SUPER simulator should not become MoSim truth; command semantics must be mapped to MWORKS setpoints.
entries.why: This gives a concrete ROS2 planner-output shape that MoSim can adapt instead of inventing a new setpoint topic blindly.
entries.required_local_gate: Map PositionCommand fields to MWORKS setpoint input and define invalid localization/stale-command fallback.
forbidden_claims: SUPER simulator proves MoSim closed-loop control
Planner command can bypass MWORKS controller/state machine
entries.next_task_candidate: Draft PlannerSetpointContract with PositionCommand-like fields and MWORKS adapter acceptance.

entries.source_version_or_runtime: ROS2 C++ local map/reference map visualization
entries.reusable_pattern: Odometry and PointCloud2 subscriptions, occupancy/unknown/inflated/esdf/frontier publishers, MarkerArray map-bound visualization
entries.version_risk: Map semantics must come after valid sensor/localization gate; do not feed full UE truth as planner map.
entries.why: This is a strong pattern for native ROS2/RViz local map review after FAST-LIO is credible.
entries.required_local_gate: Only dispatch after FAST-LIO output and truth-error gate are available for the target scene.
forbidden_claims: Local map is accepted before FAST-LIO/localization gate
Full UE collision truth is planner input
2D occupancy grid is sufficient UAV local 3D map
entries.next_task_candidate: Hold as next map review contract after Mid360/FAST-LIO input/output pass.

entries.reusable_pattern: inCtrlExt, Init/Fault/Dynamic parameter injection, process split between plant/control, UE rendering, ROS/RViz review
entries.version_risk: Packaged examples and sample parameters are not Sunray150 identified truth and may not be directly editable source.
entries.why: The process and parameter injection shape is useful for MWORKS wrappers and fault experiments.
entries.required_local_gate: MWORKS wrapper design must label parameter provenance and pass check_model/simulation before replacing baseline behavior.
forbidden_claims: RflySim sample mass/inertia/Ct/Cm are Sunray150 truth
CopterSim translates directly to one .mo file
RflySim scene packages are accepted editable UE scenes
entries.next_task_candidate: Turn RflySim fault/dynamic-parameter injection into a MWORKS wrapper design checklist.

entries.reusable_pattern: CopterSim/PX4/generated plant for motion, UE/RflySim3D for rendering/perception, ROS/RViz for algorithm review
entries.version_risk: Architecture reference is already accepted, but each runtime slice still needs local evidence.
entries.why: This is the key anti-duplication rule: MoSim should reuse the role split, not clone the runtime.
entries.required_local_gate: Every task packet must declare which layer owns truth, command, sensor, review, and evidence.
forbidden_claims: UE owns controller truth
ROS2 owns plant truth
Reference stack acceptance equals MoSim implementation acceptance
entries.next_task_candidate: Use this as PMO acceptance checklist for future cross-layer task packets.

entries.reusable_pattern: simulator runtime, physics, ROS wrapper, UE renderer
entries.version_risk: Direct runtime adoption would conflict with MWORKS authority and create duplicate simulator truth.
entries.why: AirSim is valuable as API/message/reference design, not as the MoSim core runtime.
entries.required_local_gate: No gate; rejected for direct runtime adoption unless PMO reopens architecture.
forbidden_claims: MoSim should switch core simulation to AirSim
AirSim physics replaces MWORKS
AirSim ROS output proves MoSim control
entries.next_task_candidate: Use only source/API references from AirSim rows above.

entries.version_risk: Current MoSim runtime lane is ROS2 Humble; ROS1 sources need candidate port, container, or bridge approval.
entries.why: Directly running ROS1 sources as if they were native ROS2 would produce false acceptance evidence.
entries.required_local_gate: Use ROS2 candidate build/run evidence or explicit bridge/container approval before runtime dispatch.
forbidden_claims: ROS1 FAST-LIO is a ROS2 runtime
ROS1 launch file proves ROS2 gate readiness
Static source presence proves current localization
entries.next_task_candidate: Keep as semantic reference until ROS2 candidate gate is explicitly assigned.

entries.source_family: Scene identity and existing MoSim UE registry
entries.reusable_pattern: scene_source_id, scene_id, map_id, run_id, active_scene_links, scene_source_registry, unreal_scene_profiles
entries.version_risk: Registry exists, but UI and cross-runtime echo must still be implemented.
entries.why: This is already the accepted local identity model and should be used instead of inventing new scene IDs.
entries.required_local_gate: Scene switch must echo UE-loaded, MWORKS-bound, ROS2-bound, gate-passed, and evidence path states.
forbidden_claims: Visible UE map switch is accepted scenario switch
Scene registry row is runtime evidence
UE-only map id proves ROS2/MWORKS binding
entries.next_task_candidate: Add scene/run identity fields to the command/status echo checklist.
